title: Run sverka step executor
description: Runs a single step of a sverka config as its own Nx task, with Nx-owned inputs, outputs and cache.

step.description: Fully qualified sverka step id, e.g. "ci/lint".

entry.description: sverka entry id that reaches the step. Default: the first entry that reaches it.

config.description: Path to the sverka config, relative to the workspace root. Default: the config found in the project root.

cwd.description: Directory the step runs in, relative to the workspace root. Default: the project root.

inputs.description: Values for the sverka pipeline inputs.
